Example data: the LCT region

Source: R/data.R
example_lct.Rd

A snpscape object for the lactase gene (LCT) plus 25 kb on each side, fetched with fetch_region("LCT"). It is included so that examples and tutorials work without an internet connection.

Usage

example_lct

Format

A snpscape object (see snpscape).

Source

1000 Genomes Project high-coverage phased panel. Built by data-raw/examples.R.

Examples

example_lct
#> <snpscape> 2,504 people x 1,922 SNPs (GRCh38)
#> Regions:     LCT (chr2:135,762,850-135,862,184) 
#> Populations: 26 populations in 5 super-populations
#> Steps:       fetched
